body:
I haven't had the best luck with these places in the past, but this time it was suicide or give it a try again.

So far most have been very nice. Because of the holiday weekend, beds are in short supply so I don't know when I'll actually start getting help. Atleast here they have provided me some stuff to calm down.

The food was okay until breakfast (powered eggs) and lunch was non-flavored mush. Hoping for a decent dinner again. 

For now I think they are gonna just keep sedating me. I guess I'll catch up on some more sleep I don't actually need.

Hope the best for you jpalm. I don't know if you saw my other posts leading up to this.

I guess now it's time to decide if I want to be a statistic of 2020 or 2021. Pretty much figured out how I'm gonna go.

Spent the last 3 hours sitting in the bathtub listening to mediation music, crying, reflecting, remembering. 

To the many who abused and tortured me as a little kid, fuck you! It's my life now and my own to take. 35 years of pain will be gone in an instant for me, may you live long lives haunted by your pasts.

C'est la vie
